name: Gurney House Restaurant
signature_dish: Kumaoni thali with bhatt ki churkani
why_it_matters: The Naini Retreat was the residence of the Maharaja of Pilibhit before it became a Leisure Hotels property. Gurney House is its main dining room — multi-cuisine but the Kumaoni section is what guests come back for. Live bansuri at breakfast, live music 8-10pm.
insider_tip: Ask Chef Hari Parihar to send out the Kumaoni tasting plate — it isn't on the printed menu but most reviews mention him walking the floor and customising orders.
signature_address: The Naini Retreat, Ayarpatta Slopes, Mallital, Nainital 263001

name: Panorama
signature_dish: Indian specialty thali with valley view
why_it_matters: The Manu Maharani's specialty restaurant — old-fashioned décor, table linen, outdoor seating with the full Naini Valley below. The hotel's 4-star wing now operates under Radisson Individuals Retreats; Panorama remains the formal evening room (vs Gardenia which is glasshouse all-day).
insider_tip: Panorama opens at 12:30pm — go for a late lunch, the valley view is sharper before the afternoon haze.
signature_address: The Manu Maharani, Grasmere Estate, Mallital, Nainital 263001

name: Gardenia
why_it_matters: Gardenia is the Manu Maharani's glasshouse all-day diner — angled toward the Naini valley, sunlit on a clear morning. Where the buffets land; where Panorama is the evening dress-up room, this is the daytime social room.
insider_tip: On a sunny morning the glasshouse heats up by 10am — go for the 7-9am breakfast slot when the light is at its best and the buffet is freshly laid.
signature_address: The Manu Maharani, Grasmere Estate, Mallital, Nainital 263001

name: Balrampur House Restaurant
why_it_matters: Originally the summer palace of the Maharajas of Balrampur, redesigned in 1930 in French-chateau style by European architect Mr. Mortimer. The kitchen still trains under recipes from the Balrampur royal family. Has hosted the Dalai Lama; only 15 rooms, dining is mostly for in-house guests.
insider_tip: Ring the front desk a day ahead — the restaurant prefers reservations and the kitchen will plate the royal-kitchen specialities only when given lead time. Drinks served with panoramic Naina-Peak views.

name: Pavilion Restaurant
why_it_matters: The Pavilion is one of Nainital's oldest hotels — 19th-century build at the base of Cheena Peak, originally hosted European tourists then a wing was added as a summer retreat for Indian royalty. Set among deodar trees near the High Court, Mallital. The in-house restaurant trades on the building's age more than its kitchen.
insider_tip: Reviews flag it as 'basic' rather than refined — come for the 19th-century veranda and the deodar-shaded approach rather than for the dishes. Stick to the simpler north-Indian plates.
signature_address: The Pavilion, Near High Court, Mallital, Nainital 263001

name: Boat House Club Restaurant & Bar
why_it_matters: Founded 1910 by Major C.W. Carey and a fellow officer as the Nainital Yacht Club — India's only inland-sailing club, the highest yacht club in India at 2,084m. The lake-facing bar is the surviving British-era social room on the Mall. Still a private club with restricted access.
insider_tip: Tourists are admitted on a temporary day pass — about ₹300 per head, or with a member-friend's reference. Open 10am-10pm summer; the bar terrace at sunset over Naini Lake is the unannounced point of coming.
signature_address: Boat House Club, G.B. Pant Marg (The Mall), Mallital, Nainital 263001

name: Seasons Restaurant
why_it_matters: Vikram Vintage Inn calls itself a boutique heritage stay near Mall Road and Naini Lake (42 rooms, heritage-cottage section). Seasons is its all-day dining room with valley views; The Vintage Bar is the in-house drinks lounge with karaoke and live performances on peak-season evenings.
insider_tip: Heritage status here is marketing language, not a documented founding year — go for the views and the decent multi-cuisine menu, not for protected-monument provenance. Pair Seasons dinner with a drink at the Vintage Bar.
signature_address: Vikram Vintage Inn, near Mall Road, Mallital, Nainital 263001
